'''Trevor Dewey The Light Side Is Simply Better''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Trevor Dewey]]
* '''Published:''' December 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' The Light Side Is Simply Better
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCC The Light Side Is Simply Better Dewe.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Here's a deck idea...for those who have a full set (unlike me):

This deck is based around the fact that the light side has effective force recyclers ("On the Edge") and the Dark Side does not. This deck beat a devastator deck with only Luke, Obi KFC, Lars, Owen, and Talz on the table. And Luke didnt come out until way late in the game. I had no ships in play and I was being drained for six force a turn.

Note: This is a TOURNAMENT level deck. Do not play this at home :>

== Strategy ==

As you can see this deck allows near unlimited Force regeneration for the Light Side. As well as providing numerous traps. It is semi-important to get Obi out by the midgame so a tuned version of this deck would probably replace the Luke's Back with another RoaJ.

This deck kills Tuskan Decks, Devestator Decks, and Teleporter decks. It would kill weenie Empire decks but I've never seen a weenie Empire Deck :>

Cheers!
